story_title: The Legend of the White Snake

scenes.text: The Legend of the White Snake is a famous Chinese folktale that has been told and retold for centuries, captivating audiences with its blend of romance, magic and morality.
scenes.dominant_action: A graceful white snake rests beside a misty lake with an ancient pagoda in the distance.

scenes.text: The story revolves around a complex relationship between a white snake spirit, Bai Suzhen, and a young man Xu Xian.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen in human form and Xu Xian meet on a lakeside bridge.

scenes.text: According to the legend, Bai Suzhen, a snake who has cultivated herself into a beautiful woman, falls in love with Xu Xian, a kind-hearted pharmacist.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen smiles lovingly as Xu Xian carefully prepares herbs in his pharmacy.

scenes.text: They marry, unaware of Bai Suzhen's true identity.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian celebrate their wedding beneath red silk decorations.

scenes.text: Their love is genuine and deep, but it is put to the test when a monk, Fahai, who knows Bai Suzhen's real form, decides to separate them to uphold the natural order.
scenes.dominant_action: Fahai stands on temple steps, sternly resolving to separate the couple.

scenes.text: Fahai tricks Xu Xian into giving Bai Suzhen a special wine during the Dragon Boat Festival, which causes her to reveal her true form.
scenes.dominant_action: Beside a small wine cup, Bai Suzhen becomes a white snake as Xu Xian recoils in surprise.

scenes.text: Shocked by discovering that his wife is a snake, Xu Xian faints and later dies from the shock.
scenes.dominant_action: The white snake watches over Xu Xian lying motionless, with no injury or graphic detail.

scenes.text: Bai Suzhen, desperate to save her husband, braves numerous trials to acquire a magical herb that revives him.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen in human form reaches across a rugged mountain ledge to obtain a glowing magical herb.

scenes.text: However, the tale reaches its climax when Fahai captures Bai Suzhen and imprisons her under the Leifeng Pagoda.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen sits within a softly glowing magical enclosure beneath the pagoda as Fahai seals the entrance.

scenes.text: Years later, her son with Xu Xian, who is unaware of his mother's fate, becomes a top scholar and eventually frees her.
scenes.dominant_action: Her grown scholar son welcomes Bai Suzhen as she steps out of the opened pagoda entrance.

scenes.text: The Legend of the White Snake explores themes of love, loyalty, and the conflict between supernatural beings and the human world.
scenes.dominant_action: Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian join hands beside the lake, symbolizing enduring love and loyalty.

scenes.text: It is a poignant narrative that questions the boundaries of love and the sacrifices one is willing to make for it.
scenes.dominant_action: The reunited family stands beside West Lake at sunset, with the pagoda far behind them.
